problem:
Suppose we wish to calculate the Laplace transform 

$$
L{t\operatorname{cos}⁡4t}.
$$

 
Select the correct options in the reasoning below. You may make use of the following result:

$$
L{\operatorname{cos}⁡\omega t}=\frac{s}{{s}^{2}+{\omega }^{2}},\,s>0.
$$

Let $f(t)=\operatorname{cos}⁡4t$ and $L{f(t)}=F(s).$ By the smoothness property of Laplace transforms,

$$
L{tf(t)}={{field-1}}.
$$
